keyQuestions: Which mechanism actually brings a plain-chat request onto the command workflow on every runtime: advisor brief, AGENTS.md gate, hook, skill-to-command pointer, or runner refusal?

ruledOut: Hook-level command enforcement: the contract is fail-open and every adapter returns an empty object on failure
A new per-turn gate: Gate 2 occupies that slot and the root doc has a 16 KiB budget
A fifth command registry: four hand-maintained sources already drift
Skill-to-command pointers alone: only one skill has one and pointers cannot trigger discovery
